TASK_13_DONE  fix(seed): write webmaster to public.users (commit 8e12451). Root cause: seed line 138-143 used $executeRawUnsafe to INSERT into `${schemaName}.users` (t_demo schema) but User Prisma model is @@schema("public") + @@map("users"). Auth lookup hit public.users → empty → CredentialsSignin. Fix: replace raw SQL with prisma.user.upsert() — Prisma respects @@schema mapping, so this writes to public.users regardless of the current search_path (which is still SET to t_demo for the tenant-scoped seeding that follows). Removes webmasterId + safeHash locals + SQL injection risk. Validated: dropped both existing webmaster rows, re-ran pnpm db:seed → public.users:1 / t_demo.users:0 / role=tenant_super_admin / bcrypt hash $2a$12$. Demo-login chain proven via browser. Files: packages/db/src/seed/index.ts (+16 / -7).

TASK_11_DONE  build(db): Direction J pattern for @orqafy/db (commit 26b24eb). Root cause: worker is raw Node ESM (type: module), can't load TypeScript at runtime. @orqafy/db's exports map pointed at ./src/*.ts → "Cannot find module" the moment worker imported anything. Web survived only because next.config.ts has transpilePackages: ["@orqafy/db"]. Fix mirrors the jobs pattern: pkg.json gains main/types/files + conditional exports map ({types,default} per subpath) pointing at ./dist/*.{d.ts,js}; new tsconfig.build.json emits to dist/ with declaration+sourcemap. KEY DEVIATION (Sonnet judgment call, accepted on verify): used module: CommonJS + moduleResolution: Node instead of NodeNext, to avoid rewriting every extensionless src import (e.g. `from './client'`) to NodeNext-style `from './client.js'`. ESM consumers get full named-export interop via Node's CJS static analysis (verified: import * as db from '@orqafy/db' from a type:module dir exposed all 8 named symbols + default + __esModule). Both Dockerfiles updated: `RUN pnpm --filter @orqafy/db build` inserted between db:generate and jobs build. Validated: (a) web container rebuilt → /login → signIn → Prisma session callback → /demo/dashboard reachable; (b) worker container rebuilt and started in dev stack → "[worker] Orqafy worker started" + GET :42952/api/health → HTTP 200 {"status":"ok","service":"orqafy-worker"}. Files: packages/db/package.json (rewrite), packages/db/tsconfig.build.json (new 16L), apps/worker/Dockerfile (+1L), apps/web/Dockerfile (+1L) (+43 / -8 net).
